connector: USB cable plugged into ESP32, separate from the 8 mm cable at the end cradle
clarification: 6 mm is plug thickness; underside=9 mm, so top=15 mm.
derived_value: Top height = 9 mm underside height + 6 mm plug thickness = 15 mm; B=6 in the raw reply was thickness, not the guide's top-height dimension.
datum: Perfboard top surface for heights; perfboard left and bottom edges viewed component-side up, terminals at top; USB plug fully inserted
conservative_envelope_assumptions: Apply the reported maximum 10 mm width and 6 mm thickness across the entire 20 mm projection, including strain relief; actual taper is unmeasured.
Center that envelope across the USB centerline; side-to-side asymmetry is unmeasured.
The envelope ends at the perfboard left edge; inboard jack/metal geometry is not established by these measurements.
The flexible cable diameter is measured, but its height within the connector and bend route are not. A cable axis at the plug mid-height is a reference assumption only.
The nominal mapping assumes a centered board. Existing X/Y/Z locating clearance can move the entire board and USB connector.
